language.description: Display language. 'raw' shows non-translated unique identifiers. Supported languages include English, French, German, Spanish, etc.

output_format.description: The format of the information display. Options: 'full' (default detailed text), 'html', 'xml', 'custom'.

inform_template.description: Template text for custom output format. Uses parameters surrounded by '%'. Only used if output_format is 'custom'.

log_file.description: Path to save the output log. Empty string means no log file is created.
